title: One sentence. One game.
caption:
One sentence. One game. 🎮

Claude-Code-Game-Studios is a free open-source repo that turns Claude Code into a whole game studio: 49 agents, from directors to designers to QA. You describe the idea, they plan, build and test it.
MIT license. Not affiliated with this project or with Claude.

Comment GAME and I'll send you the link. Tag a friend who wants to make a game. Follow @StickMindR8!
